task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
An underwater scene in deep blue water shows a large, dark, boxy shipwreck resting on a pale sandy seabed, viewed from a low angle looking slightly upward. A continuous vertical stream of bubbles rises from the center of the wreck toward the surface, while a second, denser plume of bubbles ascends along the right edge of the frame. Small, indistinct fish drift through the blue water around the structure. The camera slowly moves forward and pans slightly, gradually revealing more of the wreck's flat deck and superstructure on the left side, which appears as a dark, angular silhouette against the lighter blue background. The lighting is diffuse and blue-tinted, typical of deep water, with the top of the frame brighter than the shadowed wreck below.
